QUICK GUIDE & ABOUT THE SOUND

Choose a voice on the left, then tap the 16 keys to place hits. Four pages hold up to 64 steps per pattern. Right-click or Shift-click a step to adjust its velocity, probability and repeats. Pattern changes are immediate. Song chain plays your chosen pattern order.

909 and 808 modes use the Afterglow synthesis engine; they are inspired by the classic instruments, not endorsed by Roland or claimed to be circuit-perfect replicas. Stock 909 cymbals are synthesized approximations. Sample mode plays your own audio with pitch, trim, reverse, drive and pan.

Everything runs in your browser. SAVE KIT creates a portable project including samples. Your latest work is also saved on this device when storage permits. WAV render runs the same engine offline; MIDI export includes enabled steps with nonzero chance; it does not bake a stochastic performance or export the full chain. WAV export captures the selected pattern or chain for the chosen number of bars, plus a one-second tail.
